description: This file defines a React functional component 'FamilyHome' that manages family-related functionalities, including displaying linked tourists, subscribing with email, and showing alerts related to tourists. It imports React, hooks, i18next translation, and API context, and uses internal state and effects to handle data fetching and user interactions.

methods.name: subscribe
methods.description: Handles form submission for subscribing with an email, adds the email to the subscriptions list and resets the input.
